launches.title: ❓ Gauge Sentiment: See exactly how AI models talk about your brand
launches.tagline: How is your brand perceived by AI?
launches.body:
Gauge now can tell you exactly how AI models talk about your brand.

  - When put in a head-to-head against your competitors, who wins?
  - In what ways are AI models bad-mouthing your brand? Talking up your competitors?

Gauge analyzes the results of these questions to tell you the exact positives and negatives surfaced.

Beyond that, Gauge can actually trace the source of negativity back to its original destination - whether it be a
competitor website, a social post, or something else.

Here's a quick look at how that works:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRfAfOWeS7s>

If you're interested in learning how AI models talk about your brand, book a time here and we'll show you:
<https://cal.com/demo/30>

launches.title: 🚀 Gauge gives you visibility into ads in ChatGPT.
launches.tagline: 🚀 Gauge is building the intelligence layer for ChatGPT Ads
launches.body:
Gauge gives you visibility into ads in ChatGPT.

Want to know what ads your competitors are running in ChatGPT? With Gauge, you can now see exactly what ad copy is getting run against any prompt you choose.

Gauge is also a single point to manage your ChatGPT ad campaigns. Simply link your API key and get instant insights into your campaigns, ad groups, and performance.

Gauge also breaks down everything by spend, impressions, and clicks - calculating CTR and CPC on the fly.

Here’s a quick overview of how it works:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MTv4z9ShWPE>

Are you running ads in ChatGPT, or interested in seeing how your competitors are? Grab a time with our team and we’ll show you: <https://cal.com/team/gauge/demo>

launches.title: 🚀 Gauge: Your marketing agent for organic, paid, and AI search
launches.tagline: A single agent that can do the work of an entire marketing team
launches.body:
With user behavior spreading across traditional and AI search, it’s never been more important to ensure that your brand is the answer. There’s a wealth of data distributed across GA4, GSC, keywords, prompts, ads, and more. This data is incredibly rich, but fragmented and complicated to understand.

Gauge unifies all of these data sources into a single agent that can do the work of an entire marketing team. Here’s how it works:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SxdKlv--Oeo>

We started by building a best-in-class GEO/AEO platform, with a core focus on getting the right data. We quickly found that data alone isn’t enough. Our users kept asking:

1. How can I make sense of all of this prompt/answer data?
2. How does it relate to my existing data?
3. What are the actual things I need to do to move the needle?

Our agent interprets all of your data sources and executes high-value work for you. Gauge can run keyword research, analyze the competition, and track prompts over time for you. Once Gauge has all the data it needs, it can build and execute plans of attack, recommending and drafting focused content. Gauge also lives where you already work, with MCP and Slack bot support.

Gauge is already a core part of the marketing stack at some of the best YC companies - Supabase, PostHog, Mux, and more.

If you’d like to give Gauge a go, you can [try it now for free](https://www.withgauge.com/features/ask-gauge)! We also have a YC discount for 50% off your first month: FRIENDSOFYC

Our main ask is feedback - would love to see you push our agent and make it uncomfortable! What do you want a marketing agent to do for you that it can’t do today?

launches.title: Gauge - Show up in more AI answers
launches.tagline: 💡 Gauge helps your company show up in more AI answers
launches.body:
**Gauge helps your company show up more in AI answers.**

### ⚠️ Why should you care?

* [Google searches are falling for the first time ever](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/ais-threat-to-google-just-got-real-8280b4ee?utm_source=chatgpt.com) ([and Google itself is moving to AI answers](https://www.theverge.com/news/655930/google-q1-2025-earnings))
* [Gartner predicts AI chatbots will capture 25% of search volume by next year](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2024-02-19-gartner-predicts-search-engine-volume-will-drop-25-percent-by-2026-due-to-ai-chatbots-and-other-virtual-agents)

With traffic leaving search, traditional SEO is dying. Our customers are seeing inbound AI traffic **double every quarter**.

### 💡How do we help?

We measure how often you and your competitors are referenced by AI, and derive insights from changes in the data over time.

Let’s take a look at how this works:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HPXcshLuQD4

We came across this problem through an Open Source Day hosted by YC. There, we heard from a huge range of speakers, including Vercel, Elastic, Resend, and Airbyte. A consistent theme across every speaker was the new inbound they were seeing from ChatGPT.

We decided to run an experiment: [productrank.ai](http://productrank.ai).

[productrank.ai](http://productrank.ai) lets you search for a topic, and see how the top models rank them. [Check it out here!](https://productrank.ai)

In just a few weeks, we reached the front page of HN, saw over 40,000 organic users, and found our first design partners.

Our early customers include LendingTree, ChartHop, Resend, Helius, Standard Metrics, and more. If you’re curious in how often AI mentions your brand, [grab 15 minutes here and we’ll show you.](https://cal.com/caelean/15)

### **❓Asks**

* Play around with [**productrank.ai**](http://productrank.ai)!
* Curious how often AI mentions your brand? [**Grab 15 min here!**](https://cal.com/caelean/15)
* Know any marketers or SEO specialists? We’d love an intro! [**Send me their name here**](mailto:caelean@withgauge.com)!
